laws.domain: A finite tuple S=(s0,...,s(r-1)) of mathematical nonnegative integers, after framework-specific input conversion; no symbolic/traced dimensions and no representational overflow.

formulae.empty: at least one zero extent; rank remains len(S), cardinality0

laws.proof: Metadata is structural: arbitrary element values, itemsize, strides, byte order, storage placement and differentiable payload do not enter the abstract law. Native/subclass/protocol access is a separate modifier.

laws.domain: Zero or more concrete-host-shapes, padded on the left with1 to common rank.

formulae.axis: Each axis set E={d in padded dimensions | d!=1}; compatible iff |E|<=1; output unique E member or1 when E empty.
formulae.zero: broadcast(0,1)=0; broadcast(0,0)=0; broadcast(0,2) is invalid. max(dim) is not the law.

not_closed: data broadcasting kernel or sharding rank-promotion policy
laws.proof: Axis compatibility is commutative and associative where defined; right-aligned axes constrain independently. Zero is a non-unit extent and cannot be discarded.

laws.domain: Concrete source/target shapes with equal cardinality; at most one -1 and a nonzero product of other target dimensions for inference.

formulae.C: output elements have the C-order linear enumeration of input, reindexed in C order
formulae.F: output elements have the F-order linear enumeration of input, reindexed in F order
formulae.data_jacobian: for fixed legal shape/order, reshape is a linear permutation of element coordinates; JVP same permutation, VJP inverse permutation
formulae.inference: inferred=count(source)/product(known target dims), exact nonnegative integer required

not_closed: overflow, native strides and custom reshape delegation

laws.domain: Fixed valid integer/slice/newaxis/ellipsis basic selection on a concrete shape; advanced bool/integer array indexing is a separate family.

formulae.alias_address: for NumPy native basic array result, offset changes by selected starts/integers and non-newaxis strides by slice steps; newaxis is length1; exact singleton/newaxis stride choices remain native details
formulae.data_jacobian: fixed gather map has JVP selecting same coordinates and VJP scatter-add to source; integer indices themselves have no ordinary real derivative
formulae.integer: normalize i<0 by i+s; require 0<=normalized<s; remove indexed axis
formulae.slice: Python slice.indices(s), step!=0; selected coordinate a+k*t, t in range(len(range(a,b,k)))

not_closed: NumPy scalar-versus-array exception details and subclass getters

laws.domain: Native shape/rank/dtype/index choices are discrete parameters of a fixed array program; payload derivatives are a separate question.

formulae.custom: Custom metadata/protocol/reshape returns retain their own identity and possible AD behavior; native structural proof does not cover them.
formulae.metadata: No real-coordinate derivative is inferred for dimensions, rank, dtype tags or integer/bool indices. Metadata functions do not automatically detach data or custom graph-bearing return values.
formulae.payload: Reshape and fixed-index gather retain valid payload gradients. Floating/complex cast rules are explicit; crossing to integer/bool uses reference tangent-space rules, not finite-difference through dtype selection.

scope.admission_policy: Every selected endpoint links existing primary identity unchanged. Supporting source workflows do not create admitted public IDs. Aliases and divergent frameworks remain distinct.
scope.purpose: bounded source definition overlay; not API denominator admission or semantic/runtime promotion
